messages:
Maya (Support): FYI ticket #AC-9876 from Simon at AcmeCorp — manager role dashboards are blank for some managers since ~2025-02-15 18:00 UTC. Admins see data, managers see empty charts.
Simon (Customer): Repro steps I gave them: 1) log in as ops_manager 2) Console > Analytics > Team Usage 3) set range last 7 days 4) charts empty (screenshot attached). API call returned \"series: []\".
Maya (Support): Ping @Luca to triage, this is affecting a paying account and they've escalated.
Luca (Eng): I'll take a look. Can you paste the exact API call they used?
Maya (Support): From their ticket:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics/usage?org=acme&role=ops_manager&from=2025-02-08T00:00:00Z&to=2025-02-15T00:00:00Z"
```
Response body they pasted: `{ \"start\": \"2025-02-08T00:00:00Z\", \"end\": \"2025-02-15T00:00:00Z\", \"series\": [] }`
Luca (Eng): I can repro quickly on staging using their org + a user with role=ops_manager. Looks like the analytics query returns empty series when the requesting actor has different org/role context.
Luca (Eng): Query we run in analytics-service:
```
SELECT time_bucket('1h', e.ts) as bucket, count(*) as cnt
FROM events e
JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.role_id = $role_id
  AND e.ts >= $from
  AND e.ts <= $to
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;
```
Luca (Eng): Root cause hypothesis: after the permissions/refactor last week we started binding the role filter to the *requester* context. In the manager-view flow we pass role_id from the auth token instead of the target role param. For admins the auth token role matches target role so data shows; for manager accounts (who are viewing a role-scoped chart) the server applies the wrong role filter and returns no rows.
Priya (SRE): I pulled logs from analytics-service for AcmeCorp requests around the time reported; saw repeated warnings: `role_lookup: cache_miss role=ops_manager` and `org_id missing in request context, applying global retention cutoff`. Snippet: `WARN 2025-02-15T18:03:12Z analytics-service role_lookup: cache_miss role=ops_manager` then `WARN 2025-02-15T18:03:12Z analytics-service retention: org_id=null, cutoff=2025-01-17T00:00:00Z`. That explains why some legacy events were dropped.
Luca (Eng): Interesting — two separate problems intersecting: 1) wrong role param (requester vs target) and 2) org_id not propagated into analytics calls which triggers a global retention cutoff and excludes older events. Combined they produce empty series in many role-scoped views.
Maya (Support): Do we have a quick workaround to give the customer? They want something immediately while you fix.
Luca (Eng): Workarounds: a) Admins can use the console \u201cSwitch role\u201d (impersonate) to view as the target role (will surface data). b) Call the API with `include_legacy=true` (internal flag) — I'll enable a temporary endpoint flag for AcmeCorp. c) Run a direct query from infra: `SELECT ... WHERE u.role_name = 'ops_manager' AND e.org_id = <acme_org_id>` (we can run for them).
Priya (SRE): I'll flip an emergency workaround: enable `include_legacy=true` for AcmeCorp on the edge config. I'll also add an ad-hoc alert to watch for empty series counts returning >10% of requests for a tenant.
Maya (Support): Noted — I'll tell Simon we have a temporary workaround and we can run a manual backfill if needed.
Luca (Eng): Created PR 4521 to fix how analytics-service selects role filters: change to use `params.target_role_id` explicitly and require `params.org_id` be present. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/analytics/pull/4521 — includes unit tests and an integration test that reproduces the empty-series case. Commit head: `a3c9f2b`.
Luca (Eng): Plan: land PR -> canary deploy to us-east -> monitor for 30m -> promote. Estimate ETA for hotfix: ~3 hours if no rollback.
Priya (SRE): I'll schedule a canary to run in us-east and attach a short runbook: watch `analytics.series.empty_rate` and CPU. I'll also pre-warm role cache for AcmeCorp to avoid cache_miss storm.
Maya (Support): I've updated ticket AC-9876 with the workaround and ETA. Simon acknowledged, thanks for quick turnaround.
analytics-bot: Deployed include_legacy flag for tenant=acme (edge-config) at 2025-02-15T19:10:22Z :white_check_mark:
Simon (Customer): Thanks, I can see data after the workaround. Please let me know when the permanent fix is live.
Luca (Eng): Merged PR 4521 to hotfix branch, canary deploying now. Will follow up in this thread with deployment ID and post-deploy checks.
Luca (Eng): Canary deployment id: deploy-20250215-622. Post-deploy query against staging with target role returns non-empty series.
Priya (SRE): Initial canary looks good — series counts back to normal, no errors. Rolling to 3 more hosts.
Maya (Support): Simon confirmed final check: dashboards showed historical data. Marking as escalated->resolved once production deploy is complete.
Luca (Eng): Prod deploy scheduled in 45m (assuming no canary issues). Will post final note here when done.
Maya (Support): Thanks team. I'll close after final confirmation from customer. :thumbsup:
